# Ryan Morris Comedy

> Niagara-based stand-up comedian documenting live sets across Southern Ontario. Brand: COMEDY.EXE.

"I don't repeat jokes, I repeat mistakes." Ryan Morris performs unhinged crowd work, experimental anti-comedy, and dad-life material, with puppets and props. He numbers and films every set and treats comedy like a craft. He is a Monday regular at The Bomb Comedy Show (Niagara Falls), co-hosts The Green Room podcast, and performs VR comedy at Failed To Render VR. Clean sets and roast battles available. By day he works in tech (systems / data); by night he ships sets. Dual identity: comedian + developer at github.com/hackmods. Based in the Niagara Region (Niagara Falls / St. Catharines), performing venues including Laugh Lab / Bomb Comedy Tour, Spotlight Comedy Club, Local Laughs, Failed To Render, and Rose City Comedy Collective.
